[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      queue_filename:\n        description: \"Queue filename under .github/save-queue/\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||\n      (\n        github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n        startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n        github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n      )\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

**ChatGPT** *(2026/10/14 19:41:52)*

確認したところ、PR #1103 の取り込み自体は成功している一方、後続の自動処理が `action_required` で止まっている。保存キューの内容を重複登録する必要はないし、PRを直接マージして迂回することもしない。

いま必要なのは、**GitHub Actions が要求している実行許可を通して、正規保存ワークフローを動かすこと**だよ。

原因も特定できた。大容量取り込みワークフローが `GITHUB_TOKEN` でキューPRを作成しているため、そのPR作成をきっかけにする後続ワークフローが自動起動されていない可能性が高い。単にPRの承認を待つだけでは進まない。

この環境からワークフローを手動起動する操作はできないので、ここだけ実行をお願いしたい。

1. [Save request intake — GitHub Actions](https://github.com/takalenny-blip/ai-project/actions/workflows/save-request-intake.yml) を開く。
2. **Run workflow** を押す。
3. `queue_filename` に `20261014_20261014_1532.md` を入力して実行する。

これでキューPRから原本を読み、正規保存用PRを作る設計だよ。その後は、正規保存PRのCI・承認・マージと、`docs/現在状態.json` の読み戻しまで確認する。**いまはキュー登録済み、正規保存は未完了**として扱うね。

[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      queue_filename:\n        description: \"Queue filename under .github/save-queue/\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||\n      (\n        github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n        startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n        github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n      )\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          QUEUE_FILENAME: ${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/$QUEUE_FILENAME\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n\n          # Queue files from automated intake live on the queue PR branch, not main.\n          # Resolve the unique open save-request PR containing the requested file.\n          mapfile -t prs < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"chat-save-request/\")) | [.number,.headRefName] | @tsv')\n          matches=()\n          for item in \"${prs[@]}\"; do\n            read -r number head_ref <<< \"$item\"\n            if gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | grep -Fxq \"$queue_file\"; then\n              head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n              matches+=(\"$number\"\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.head_sha }}\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n\\t'\"$head_ref\"\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - [L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      queue_filename:\n        description: \"Queue filename under .github/save-queue/\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||\n      (\n        github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n        startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n        github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n      )\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          QUEUE_FILENAME: ${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/$QUEUE_FILENAME\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n\n          # Queue files from automated intake live on the queue PR branch, not main.\n          # Resolve the unique open save-request PR containing the requested file.\n          mapfile -t prs < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"chat-save-request/\")) | [.number,.headRefName] | @tsv')\n          matches=()\n          for item in \"${prs[@]}\"; do\n            read -r number head_ref <<< \"$item\"\n            if gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | grep -Fxq \"$queue_file\"; then\n              head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n              matches+=(\"$number\"$'\\t'\"$head_ref\"$'\\t'\"$head_sha\")\n            fi\n          done\n          if [ \"${#matches[@]}\" -ne 1 ]; then\n            printf 'Expected exactly one open save-request PR for %s; found %s\\n' \"$queue_file\" \"${#matches[@]}\" >&2\n            printf '%s\\n' \"${matches[@]}\" >&2\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          IFS=$'\\t' read -r pr_number head_ref head_sha <<< \"${matches[0]}\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"source_pr=$pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.head_sha }}\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

**ChatGPT** *(2026/10/14 19:44:23)*

ログを確認できた。今回の失敗原因は Dropbox でも、ファイルのサイズでもない。**保存ワークフロー側の不整合**だよ。

手動実行では `main` をチェックアウトしているのに、対象の `20261014_20261014_1532.md` は未マージの PR #1103 のブランチ上にある。そのため、ワークフローが `main` から対象ファイルを探して失敗している。さっき案内した手動実行だけでは解決しなかった。そこは案内が不十分だった。ごめん。

原因を直す修正PRを作成し、チェックの成功まで確認したよ。

- [PR #1104 — 手動保存ワークフローの読み込み不具合を修正](https://github.com/takalenny-blip/ai-project/pull/1104)
- 修正内容：`main` ではなく、対象ファイルを持つ保存キューPRのブランチから原本を読む
- `current-state-guard`：成功
